products.title: Paniermehl Asia glutenfrei
products.description:
Gelbliches, glutenfreies Decor-Paniermehl, mit Curry und Kokosraspeln, zum Panieren von Geflügel, Fleisch, Fisch, Käse und Gemüse.

**Dosierung:** nach Bedarf.

**Zutaten:** Paniermehl glutenfrei (Reis, Mais, Dextrose, Speisesalz); Kokosflocken; Gewürze.

en.title: Breadcrumbs Asia gluten-free
en.subtitle: Decor breadcrumbs gluten-free
en.description:
Yellowish, gluten-free decor breadcrumbs with curry and grated coconut, for coating poultry, meat, fish, cheese and vegetables.

**Dosage:** as required.

**Ingredients:** gluten-free breadcrumbs (rice, maize, dextrose, table salt); coconut flakes; spices.

it.title: Pangrattato Asia senza glutine
it.subtitle: Pangrattato decorativo senza glutine
it.description:
Pangrattato decorativo giallastro e senza glutine, con curry e cocco grattugiato, per impanare pollame, carne, pesce, formaggio e verdure.

**Dosaggio:** secondo necessità.

**Ingredienti:** pangrattato senza glutine (riso, mais, destrosio, sale da cucina); scaglie di cocco; spezie.
